input: The solar system has eight planets.
Pluto is one of the eight planets in the solar system.
Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars are the four terrestrial planets in our solar system.
Uranus and Neptune are classified as gas giants by NASA.
Jupiter is one of the four innermost terrestrial planets.
One mole contains exactly 6.02214076 × 10^23 specified elementary entities.
The SI meter is defined using a fixed speed of light of 299,792,457 meters per second.
The SI second uses the cesium-133 transition frequency fixed at 9,192,631,770 hertz.
The SI kilogram is still defined by the mass of a particular platinum-iridium cylinder.
The SI candela is defined using monochromatic radiation at 540 hertz.
More than 96 percent of Earth's total water is saline, according to the USGS water-distribution estimate.
Over 68 percent of Earth's freshwater is stored in ice caps, glaciers, and permanent snow.
Rivers contain about one percent of all water on Earth.
Fresh groundwater accounts for about 30 percent of Earth's total water supply.
The USGS says sunlight and gravity drive the continual movement of water on Earth.
Typical seawater contains close to 35 grams of dissolved salts per liter.
Of the five ocean basins, the Atlantic is the saltiest on average.
NOAA identifies the Red Sea and Persian Gulf region as ocean areas with salinity around 40 parts per thousand.
Seawater with 35 parts per thousand salinity freezes at about 0 degrees Celsius.
Ice floats because it is denser than liquid water.
